body: Was quite excited about the gamification of ToDo list but disappointed to note that server was not connectable. Needs to review availability and maintenance procedures in order to retain user’s perception reliability. Availability is a key concern.
author: Jeremy 5.

title: I prefer it on the browser
body: I prefer using Habitica on my laptop via browser. The app really isn’t that wonderful but all that is needed is there I guess. It would be better if I could see the pending damage for bosses and stuff though. And maybe if it notified me of notifications from my party. Tends to require manual refreshing but other than the aforementioned stuff all’s well.
author: Emkay16

title: Good idea but app needs improvement
body: I've been using habitica for about 3 months now and it has changed my life for the better. However, the last update changed the interface on the iPhone app such that you can't view the top and bottom of the screen. I hope the developers would fix this problem as it's an otherwise great way to stay motivated...
